bootstrap.scheme: Resample parents within true participant class; fixed observed class-parent counts; all legs carried together
bootstrap.pairing: Identical parent multiplicities for both teacher generations and both representations
bootstrap.sensitivity: Each parent has total weight one
bootstrap.calibration: Point estimates only; no posthoc calibration or confidence-based selection
bootstrap.limits: Conditional on fixed teachers, one new validation episode, observed class mix, same city/public demand and known bus lines; no training-seed or simulation-episode uncertainty; descriptive intervals, no multiplicity correction

selection: Fixed final epoch50 seed42 teachers; no fitting or score-based model selection

leg.scope: Training and fresh-val populations differ; gap is diagnostic, not a paired data-scale effect

speed_input_definition.source: Observed XY cumulative arc; one-second increments, 128 relative-index samples
speed_input_definition.image: Unchanged G23 speed_images, fixed35m/s scale,8bins GASF/GADF/MTF; G28 resizing/normalization
speed_input_definition.short_leg_rule: >=1s uses inherited profile; <1s repeats observed arc/span mean128 times; no row exclusion
speed_input_definition.label: Five participant classes, not speed-bin labels
speed_input_definition.high_frequency_limit: One-second summaries resampled to128 points do not preserve all native acceleration

parent_isolation.meaning: Shared old-val identities are fresh random realizations, not unseen demand templates

scale_claim_limit: G35 versus G33 changes data volume, native demand/time coverage and CNN optimizer update count at fixed50epochs; paired common-val improvement is a corpus-plus-training-recipe result, not isolated sample-size causality
GAF_claim_limit: Real SUMO observation classification measures label information and reliability; it does not prove improved synthetic trajectories or guidance benefit
